declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.adicNumeratorDigits
declarations.contract:
def adicNumeratorDigits : Nat → Int → List Nat
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, a =>
      let d := ((-a) % 10).toNat
      d :: adicNumeratorDigits n ((a - 9 * (d : Int)) / 10)

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits
declarations.contract:
def fractionDigits : Nat → Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | 0, _, _ => []
  | n + 1, r, D =>
      (10 * r) / D :: fractionDigits n ((10 * r) % D) D

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.adicNumeratorDigits_length
declarations.contract:
@[simp] theorem adicNumeratorDigits_length (n : Nat) (a : Int) :
    (adicNumeratorDigits n a).length = n

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits_length
declarations.contract:
@[simp] theorem fractionDigits_length (n r D : Nat) :
    (fractionDigits n r D).length = n

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.adicNumeratorDigits_bounded
declarations.contract:
theorem adicNumeratorDigits_bounded (n : Nat) (a : Int) :
    ∀ d ∈ adicNumeratorDigits n a, d ≤ 9

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.adicNumeratorDigits_prefix
declarations.contract:
theorem adicNumeratorDigits_prefix (n m : Nat) (a : Int) :
    (adicNumeratorDigits (n + m) a).take n = adicNumeratorDigits n a

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.adicNumeratorDigits_column
declarations.contract:
theorem adicNumeratorDigits_column (n x : Nat) (z : Int) :
    adicNumeratorDigits (n + 1) (9 * (x : Int) + 10 * z) =
      x % 10 :: adicNumeratorDigits n (9 * ((x / 10 : Nat) : Int) + z)

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.adicNumeratorDigits_constant
declarations.contract:
theorem adicNumeratorDigits_constant (n t : Nat) (ht : t < 10) :
    adicNumeratorDigits n (-(t : Int)) = List.replicate n t

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.adicNumeratorDigits_normalize
declarations.contract:
theorem adicNumeratorDigits_normalize (B : List Nat) (e q : Nat) (c : Int) :
    adicNumeratorDigits (B.length + q)
      (9 * ((lowValue B + e : Nat) : Int) - c * 10 ^ B.length) =
      (normalize B e).1 ++
        adicNumeratorDigits q (9 * ((normalize B e).2 : Int) - c)

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.adicNumeratorDigits_phase
declarations.contract:
theorem adicNumeratorDigits_phase (c e q : Nat) (hc : nonneutralPhase c)
    (he : e ≤ 1) :
    adicNumeratorDigits (q + 1) (9 * (e : Int) - (c : Int)) =
      (c + e - 10 * (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0)) ::
        List.replicate q (c - 9 * (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0))

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.adicNumeratorDigits_exterior
declarations.contract:
theorem adicNumeratorDigits_exterior (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) (q : Nat)
    (hc : nonneutralPhase c) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18) :
    adicNumeratorDigits (B.length + 1 + q) (zValue c B - (c : Int)) =
      (normalize B 0).1 ++
        [c + (normalize B 0).2 - 10 * (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0)] ++
        List.replicate q (c - 9 * (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0))

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits_scale
declarations.contract:
theorem fractionDigits_scale (n r D s : Nat) (hs : 0 < s) :
    fractionDigits n (s * r) (s * D) = fractionDigits n r D

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits_repeat
declarations.contract:
theorem fractionDigits_repeat (q t : Nat) (ht : t < 9) :
    fractionDigits q t 9 = List.replicate q t

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.highValue_cons_digit
declarations.contract:
theorem highValue_cons_digit (x : Nat) (xs : List Nat) :
    highValue (x :: xs) = x * 10 ^ xs.length + highValue xs

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.highValue_lt_pow
declarations.contract:
theorem highValue_lt_pow (W : List Nat) (hW : ∀ x ∈ W, x < 10) :
    highValue W < 10 ^ W.length

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits_of_highValue
declarations.contract:
theorem fractionDigits_of_highValue (W : List Nat) (t q : Nat)
    (hW : ∀ x ∈ W, x < 10) (ht : t < 9) :
    fractionDigits (W.length + q) (9 * highValue W + t) (9 * 10 ^ W.length) =
      W ++ List.replicate q t

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.normalize_value_conservation
declarations.contract:
theorem normalize_value_conservation (B : List Nat) (carry : Nat) :
    lowValue (normalize B carry).1 +
        10 ^ B.length * (normalize B carry).2 = lowValue B + carry

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.normalize_digits_lt_ten
declarations.contract:
theorem normalize_digits_lt_ten (B : List Nat) (carry : Nat) :
    ∀ x ∈ (normalize B carry).1, x < 10

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.highValue_reverse_word
declarations.contract: theorem highValue_reverse_word (W : List Nat) : highValue W.reverse = lowValue W

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.phase_tail_digit
declarations.contract:
theorem phase_tail_digit (c : Nat) (hc : nonneutralPhase c) :
    c = 9 * (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0) + (c - 9 * (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0)) ∧
      c - 9 * (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0) < 9

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits_exterior
declarations.contract:
theorem fractionDigits_exterior (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) (q : Nat)
    (hc : nonneutralPhase c) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18) :
    let k := if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0
    let t := c - 9 * k
    let g := (normalize B.reverse k).2
    fractionDigits (B.length + 1 + q) (rhoNum c B) (9 * 10 ^ B.length * 10 ^ g) =
      (if g == 0 then (normalize B.reverse k).1.reverse ++ [t]
       else [1] ++ (normalize B.reverse k).1.reverse) ++ List.replicate q t

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits_prefix
declarations.contract:
theorem fractionDigits_prefix (n q r D : Nat) :
    (fractionDigits (n + q) r D).take n = fractionDigits n r D

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits_digits_lt_ten
declarations.contract:
theorem fractionDigits_digits_lt_ten (n r D : Nat) (hr : r < D) :
    ∀ d ∈ fractionDigits n r D, d < 10

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits_exterior_digits_lt_ten
declarations.contract:
theorem fractionDigits_exterior_digits_lt_ten (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) (n : Nat)
    (hc : nonneutralPhase c) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18) :
    let k := if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0
    let g := (normalize B.reverse k).2
    ∀ d ∈ fractionDigits n (rhoNum c B) (9 * 10 ^ B.length * 10 ^ g), d < 10

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.strip_zip_append_replicate
declarations.contract:
theorem strip_zip_append_replicate (a b : List Nat) (t q : Nat)
    (hlen : a.length = b.length) :
    stripSuffix (2 * t)
      (List.zipWith (fun x y => x + y)
        (a ++ List.replicate q t) (b ++ List.replicate q t)) =
    stripSuffix (2 * t) (List.zipWith (fun x y => x + y) a b)

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.outerNext_from_streams
declarations.contract:
theorem outerNext_from_streams (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) (q : Nat)
    (hc : nonneutralPhase c) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18) :
    outerNext { c := c, B := B } =
      { c := bulkPhase c,
        B := stripSuffix (bulkPhase c)
          (List.zipWith (fun x y => x + y)
            (adicNumeratorDigits (B.length + 1 + q) (zValue c B - (c : Int)))
            (fractionDigits (B.length + 1 + q) (rhoNum c B)
              (9 * 10 ^ B.length *
                10 ^ (normalize B.reverse (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0)).2))) }

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.outerNext_from_streams_of_cutoff
declarations.contract:
theorem outerNext_from_streams_of_cutoff (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) (cut : Nat)
    (hc : nonneutralPhase c) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18)
    (hcut : B.length + 1 ≤ cut) :
    outerNext { c := c, B := B } =
      { c := bulkPhase c,
        B := stripSuffix (bulkPhase c)
          (List.zipWith (fun x y => x + y)
            (adicNumeratorDigits cut (zValue c B - (c : Int)))
            (fractionDigits cut (rhoNum c B)
              (9 * 10 ^ B.length *
                10 ^ (normalize B.reverse (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0)).2))) }
